svg.title: CASTAWAY on a phone screen
svg.desc: A coral candybar phone lies face up on island sand. Its two-tone green LCD shows the idle screen CASTAWAY, No network, Menu, then cycles through picture messages: a bottle drifting straight back, a parcel of headphones, a palm climb for one bar of signal, a shark nodding in headphones, the synthesized tones, a typical 10-hour schedule and the command python tools/serve.py, then a snake laps the logo back on.
